scenes.supernova_script:
Priya says: Miss Nova, how do I reply in English to 'When are you coming?'
Miss Nova says: Never say, 'I will return back on Monday'.
Priya says: Right, not 'return back'. Return already means coming back. Using both is a common mistake. I should just say, 'I will return on Monday'.
Miss Nova says: Perfect! And you used to say you don't know English at all.
Priya says: I was just scared of being judged! But on Supernova AI, I practice privately with you.
Miss Nova says: Exactly. I analyze your speech and build a personalized plan just for you.
Priya says: Plus, it's 7 times cheaper than normal English classes.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hook: Common Indian-English error correction
- Payload beat (b): Privacy and no-judgement introduced naturally
- Payload beat (a): Miss Nova explains the personalized plan
- Payload beat (g): Logic explained clearly
